issues.water-now-twice: Double-clicking 'Water now' on the beds page sends two POST /api/waterings requests and records two waterings, because the button is not disabled while the request is in flight.
issues.negative-litres: The beds page past-watering form and POST /api/waterings accept negative (and zero or negative-infinite) litres such as -5 and list them as negative amounts.
issues.huge-integer-id-500: POST /api/waterings, GET /api/waterings?bed_id= and DELETE /api/waterings/{id} return 500 when given an integer id larger than 64 bits, such as 99999999999999999999.
issues.nonfinite-litres-500: POST /api/waterings returns 500 instead of 422 when litres is NaN or overflows to infinity, such as 1e400.
issues.ancient-watering-date-accepted: POST /api/waterings and the past-watering form accept implausible dates such as 0001-01-01 and list them as '1 Jan 1'.
issues.tiny-litres-shown-as-zero: Past waterings with tiny litre amounts such as 0.001 are accepted despite the field's 0.1 minimum and then displayed as '0 L' in lists and notices.
issues.shared-busy-flag-across-beds: On the beds page a single shared wateringBedId means clicking Water now on a second bed while the first is pending re-enables the first bed's button early (allowing a duplicate) and mixes up busy states and messages.
issues.watering-requests-no-timeout: Watering requests (Water now, Save watering, waterings list and delete) have no 10 s timeout, so a hung request leaves 'Watering…', 'Saving…' or 'Loading waterings…' on screen indefinitely.
issues.watering-post-no-idempotency: POST /api/waterings has no idempotency key or dedupe, so retrying Water now or Save watering after a lost or timed-out response records a duplicate watering.
issues.water-refresh-failure-loses-confirmation: On the beds page, when Water now succeeds but the follow-up GET /api/beds refresh fails, the bed list is replaced by 'Could not load beds.' or an error is shown and the save confirmation is lost, inviting a duplicate retry.
issues.waterings-load-error-no-retry: When GET /api/waterings fails, the dashboard 'Recent waterings' section and the /waterings page show only an error message with no Retry control, so recovery requires a reload.
issues.auth-me-error-no-retry: On /login, after GET /api/auth/me fails with 500 or similar, there is no way to retry without reloading the page.
issues.login-error-no-retry: On /login, after POST /api/auth/login fails with 500 or similar, retrying does not reach the Dashboard without a reload.
issues.upcoming-tasks-error-no-retry: On the dashboard, after GET /api/tasks/upcoming fails with 500 or similar, there is no way to retry without a reload.
issues.dashboard-summary-error-no-retry: On the dashboard, after GET /api/dashboard/summary fails with 500 or similar, there is no way to retry without a reload.
issues.waterings-malformed-json-crash: Opening /waterings when GET /api/waterings returns malformed JSON throws an uncaught render error and shows the dev error overlay.
issues.dashboard-summary-malformed-json-undefin: The dashboard shows the text 'undefined' when GET /api/dashboard/summary returns malformed JSON.
issues.upcoming-tasks-malformed-json-nan: The dashboard shows the text 'NaN' when GET /api/tasks/upcoming returns malformed JSON.
issues.water-now-hang-uncaught-error: On /beds, when POST /api/waterings hangs, an uncaught error appears in the dev error overlay.
issues.add-bed-hang-uncaught-error: On /beds, when POST /api/beds hangs, an uncaught error appears in the dev error overlay.
issues.beds-malformed-json-crash: On /beds, when GET /api/beds returns malformed JSON, the page throws an uncaught render error and the 'Add bed' button stays disabled on 'Adding…'.
issues.add-bed-values-lost-on-beds-error: On /beds, when GET /api/beds fails after adding a bed, the typed bed name is cleared and the retry does not recover.
issues.waterings-bed-select-bad-input-crash: On /waterings, choosing unexpected values in the 'Bed' filter select causes an uncaught error in the dev error overlay.
issues.litres-bad-input-crash: On /beds, entering bad values such as negatives into the 'Litres' field causes an uncaught error in the dev error overlay.
issues.beds-reload-uncaught-error: Reloading /beds or returning to it via back/forward causes an uncaught error in the dev error overlay.
issues.waterings-signed-out-reload-crash: Reloading /waterings while signed out causes an uncaught error in the dev error overlay.
issues.upcoming-tasks-429-uncaught-error: On the dashboard, a 429 response from GET /api/tasks/upcoming causes an uncaught error in the dev error overlay.
issues.waterings-beds-malformed-json-crash: Opening /waterings when GET /api/beds returns malformed JSON or 500 throws an uncaught render error.
issues.waterings-beds-error-silent: On /waterings, when GET /api/beds fails, the error is ignored and the Bed filter silently offers only 'All beds' with no message or retry.
issues.invalid-bed-query-raw-message: Opening /waterings?bed=abc (or an unknown bed id) shows the raw validation text 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer…' and a filter select with no matching option.
issues.long-bed-name-table-overflow: A long bed name without spaces makes the waterings tables on /waterings and the dashboard overflow the 375 px viewport because cells do not wrap.
issues.huge-litres-overflow-layout: A stored extreme litres value such as -1e308 renders as a several-hundred-digit number that forces sideways scrolling on /waterings and the dashboard at 375 px.
issues.watering-date-timezone-mismatch: The future-date check and Water now's watered_on use the server's local date while the client uses the browser's date and UTC times, so a user ahead of the server can have today's date refused as 'in the future' and entries can land on the wrong day.
issues.datetime-ssr-timezone-mismatch: Watering timestamps are formatted without a fixed time zone, so server-rendered times use the server's zone and can mismatch the browser's on hydration.
issues.delete-missing-watering-error: Deleting a watering that was already deleted (second tab or retry) on /waterings shows a 404 'Watering not found.' error and leaves the stale row instead of refreshing.
issues.boolean-litres-accepted: POST /api/waterings accepts litres: true and stores it as 1.0 L instead of returning 422.
issues.dashboard-waterings-no-loading-state: The dashboard 'Recent waterings' section shows nothing but its heading while GET /api/waterings is pending on client-side navigation.
issues.waterings-filter-stale-results: On /waterings, quickly changing the bed filter or a failed refetch can leave the previous bed's rows shown under the new filter or above the error.
issues.waterings-filter-not-synced-to-url: On /waterings the bed filter is read from the URL only once, so navigating from /waterings?bed=1 to /waterings or using back/forward keeps the old filter.
issues.waterings-navigation-blocked-while-loadi: Clicking the Waterings nav link while GET /api/waterings hangs leaves the previous page on screen indefinitely with no loading indicator.
issues.water-now-check-no-post-after-reload: After reloading / or /waterings, the app-water-now-records-once check fails because no POST /api/waterings is sent at all.
